tien_ngu_phan.wants: To clear his table debts to Kim Vạn Lý and one day to call the auction floor his own.
tien_ngu_phan.secret: In the lot he is selling Hách Ánh Hà he shaves a stone off each child's price and pockets the difference in a silk lining, to pay Kim Vạn Lý's table before the autumn auction.

ho_tam_ky.wants: A living lot no one has ever seen at auction, and her own name on the lot-book beside it.
ho_tam_ky.secret: She is forging bills of health for sickly beasts in Mộc Lan, and one of them, a fire-eyed mule, will die within the week in a rich man's stable.
ho_tam_ky.add: She sells half-dead lots under a forged bill of health, and has not once gone back to see them die.

nguy_minh_giam.wants: The mistress's floor and the mistress's eye, and to learn what the unpriced line in the vault book means.
nguy_minh_giam.secret: At the back of the lot book she grades the mistress's own lots in red ink, a stone high or low, to prove she can; Tả Thức Bảo copies the book and has not yet seen the pages.

an_toan_chau.app: Grey ash worked into the creases of her knuckles and a wheeze she muffles in a sleeve.

vien_hong_kim.add: He teaches new hands respect by holding their wrists to the furnace door.
vien_hong_kim.app: Eyelashes burned to nothing and the furnace door's brand on his left wrist.

cat_kim_sa.add: He told no one about the slag; the walk to the office was long.
cat_kim_sa.app: Red-gold dust glitter on his cheekbones that no wash removes.

tong_thach_mach.add: Three times the test failed him by a hair.
tong_thach_mach.app: A well-digger's stooped shoulders and a habit of ducking doorways.

khong_linh_thanh.app: A silk scarf wound round her throat to save the voice.

quan_tay_ngoc.app: Water-wrinkled fingertips and bare, cold-reddened feet.

thuong_toi_kim.add: He fails a refining by his mood of the morning.
thuong_toi_kim.app: A forearm tattooed with the furnace vow, one line scratched out.

phong_tu_gia.app: Heavy rings on every finger but the one she weighs with.

tuyen_thach_nha.app: A string of brass weights clinking at her belt.

mau_hong_sa.app: A gold-flecked front tooth, picked up in the pit.

ta_thuc_bao.app: An inked copyist's cuff and a collar buttoned too high.

quan_tay_lan.app: A strand of brook weed always tangled in her hair.

doan_tri_lung.app: Bite-scar crescents up both arms, each one named.
